observations.reading: The initial blind reading reconstructed the marginal square, joint diagonal x+y=1, and projections [0,2] and {1}. A left-to-right reading connects constraints with their combined labour. The x+y axis and equality annotation expose the projection.
observations.annotation_burden: Direct labels avoid a separate legend. The lower-triangle exclusion takes one inferential step using the two-hour task totals. The rotated diagonal label adds a small reading burden but has no collision.
observations.reproduction: Readable colour and greyscale previews at 152.4 by 80 mm; 8.5--9.5 pt labels. Dark diagonal and diamond retain identity without colour.

observations.reading: Same square and diagonal above the combined-total comparison. Quantities and result can be recovered, but x+y axis/equality cues are absent.
observations.annotation_burden: Row labels sit nearer their marks, modestly aiding row identification. The plotting areas shift horizontally between panels, lengthening the visual path.
observations.reproduction: Same physical square and interval lengths, readable in greyscale, at 152.4 by 111 mm. Its additional 31 mm height does not resolve a collision or substantive reading problem.

initial_reconstruction.claim: First-hour capacity x+y<=1 and second-hour remaining labour 2-x-y<=1 intersect in x+y=1. Separately summed bounds give [0,2], while joint constraints give {1}.
quantities: x: first-hour labour on Task A in person-hours.
y: first-hour labour on Task B in person-hours.
x+y: combined first-hour labour, with common 0--2 scale in panel (b).
initial_reconstruction.evidence_status: The caption explicitly identifies a constructed example, not measured evidence.
initial_reconstruction.scope: One person, two one-person-hour tasks and a two-hour completion window. The marks give interval totals rather than complete work schedules.
unintended_inferences: Shading can initially suggest joint feasibility; the regional labels, diagonal label and caption distinguish the square from the joint set.
The lower triangle requires reasoning about remaining work in the second hour.
Vertical positions of the rows in panel (b) have no quantitative meaning.

matches: The reconstructed inequalities and projected sets match the specification and exact rational calculation.
Fractional interval totals, deterministic status and the complete-schedule limitation remain clear.
Selected composition uses 31 mm less height while retaining the same plotted scales and the stronger projection labels.

findings.description: Readers may initially treat every shaded point as jointly feasible.
findings.reason: The two excluded-region labels, directly labelled diagonal and caption explicitly state the separate-versus-joint distinction. The alternative retains the same residual burden.

findings.description: The rotated label requires a small reading effort.
findings.reason: It follows the plotted line, avoids other marks and remains readable at final size and in greyscale.

audit_warning_dispositions.reason: The standalone class reports shell escape disabled. The ordinary TikZ picture compiles without external commands; enabling shell escape is unnecessary.

limitations: Human interpretation benefit remains unmeasured by agent screening.
The skill schemas were available, but its bundled scripts were unavailable; the mechanical checks are the declared project-local subset.
The exact aggregate is a consequence of saturation in this constructed case; shared capacity need not always point-identify aggregate labour.
